description: Owner taste brief cards (categories visual, writing, dont): short rules for how things should be made. Each card has inspect_url. Not hobbies, icks, or a dump of learned facts. Optional category filter; include_retracted returns soft-retracted cards too. ($0.05; API key required)

category.description: Taste category filter: visual, writing or dont, e.g. visual.

include_retracted.description: Include soft-retracted taste cards, e.g. false.

name: get_taste_profile

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

items.description: Taste card with card_id, category, rule, note, source, state, confidence, inspect_url.

categories.description: Counts of live cards by category.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.
